resources.string: You\'re signed in. This credential is saved and reused across all your projects.
Sign in with your GitHub account. We\'ll show you a short code to enter on github.com; the resulting access is stored securely and reused for every project.
Tap the code to copy it, then open GitHub and paste it:
Waiting for you to authorize on GitHub…
Pushing to %1$s needs a GitHub personal access token (classic or fine-grained) with repository write access. It\'s stored securely and reused for future push/pull.
When you\'re done on GitHub, come back here. Cloud Build checks again by itself.
Your project is saved on this phone.
Android Studio Lite builds your app on GitHub\'s servers using your own GitHub account. Your project goes to a private space in your account that only you can see.
GitHub is no longer letting Cloud Build use your account. Your build storage is still there.
Allow access to your build storage
On GitHub, choose “Only select repositories”, pick “asl-build”, then tap “Install”. Cloud Build can\'t see anything else in your account.
Don\'t have build storage yet? Create it first.
Access to your build storage was suspended on GitHub. Resume it there, then come back.
Cloud Build keeps a copy of your project here while it builds. GitHub opens with everything filled in. Just tap “Create repository”.
Android Studio Lite creates a private repository named “asl-build” on your GitHub account and keeps a copy of your project there while it builds.
Private build storage is ready. Now allow Cloud Build to use it.
Your private build storage already exists. Now allow Cloud Build to use it.
A repository named “asl-build” already exists and is public, so it was left untouched. Make it private on GitHub, then check again.
Your Git sign-in is @%1$s, but Cloud Build uses @%2$s, so nothing was created. Create the build storage on GitHub instead.
Your GitHub sign-in isn\'t allowed to create private repositories. Create the build storage on GitHub instead.
Your Git sign-in has expired. Sign in again under Settings › Git & GitHub, or create the build storage on GitHub.
Sign in under Settings › Git & GitHub to let Android Studio Lite create it, or create it on GitHub.
You\'re offline. Try again when you\'re connected.
GitHub isn\'t responding. Try again in a moment.
Cloud Build can\'t reach your build storage
It may have been deleted, renamed, or removed from Cloud Build\'s access on GitHub. Your projects on this phone are safe.
Anyone could see the code you build. Make it private on GitHub, then come back.
Cloud Build needs updated access on GitHub to keep building. GitHub shows exactly what changed.
Cloud Build needs an internet connection.
GitHub asked Cloud Build to slow down
Try again in a few minutes.
